--- Page 1 ---
Historical Record Report Volume 1

The All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) found no verifiable evidence that
any U.S. government program has possessed or reverse-engineered extraterrestrial technology.

AARO assesses that the majority of reported UAP cases can be explained by misidentification
of ordinary objects, sensor artifacts, or foreign intelligence collection platforms.

Congressional reporting requirements under the FY2023 NDAA mandate annual UAP disclosures
to designated committees.
